{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string with commas to float
# First, replace any non-numeric characters (like commas) and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (should be 6, per documentation)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Check if any refunded orders exist
refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Refunded orders:", len(refunded))"}
